# updawg_organization (Data Source)

The organization the token belongs to. Also the quickest check that a token and slug work together.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "updawg_organization" "this" {}

output "plan" {
  value = data.updawg_organization.this.plan
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `org` (String) The organization's slug. Defaults to the provider's `org`.

### Read-Only

- `agent_auto_update` (Boolean) Whether agents are kept on the stable channel automatically.
- `id` (String) The organization's id.
- `name` (String) Its display name.
- `plan` (String) Its plan: `free`, `team`, `business` or `enterprise`.
- `role` (String) The role of the person who issued the token. A token can do at most what this role allows.
- `stale_after_minutes` (Number) Minutes without a check-in before a host is marked stale.
